children: is recalling 27,185 of its flagship Air luxury sedans in the U.S., because an exterior lighting circuit could overheat and increase the risk of a fire, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said on Friday.
The recall notice asked owners to park their vehicles outside and away from structures until a remedy is deployed.
Lucid has released an over-the-air software update to address the issue, NHTSA said.
